o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bū (“this”) Compare Old Turkic 𐰉𐰆 (b¹w /⁠bu⁠/, “this”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آیاز (ayaz), from Proto-Turkic *ayaŕ.

Morphologically yeddi + -inci. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰘𐰃𐱅𐰨 (yetinči, “seventh”),
Turkish yedinci, Turkmen ýedinji, Kazakh жетінші (jetinši), etc.
Ultimately from Italian postiglione, via French postillon, via Russian почтальо́н (počtalʹón).
